evidence.reason: At current line 644, the stale-checkout path calls non-forced `git worktree remove` after only the unpushed-commit guard. Git's non-forced worktree removal checks tracked/untracked status without ignored files, so ignored content can be deleted while the removal succeeds; because it succeeds, `onStaleRefresh` is never invoked. This is an existing safe-removal gap, not merely a new contract requirement. The asserted second removal path at line 782 has the same pattern.
